items.description: Ensure unit test coverage for individual modules before proceeding to server-core integration phase.

goal_spec.objective: Remediate all 46 approved audit findings identified in path_a_seed across the codebase
non_goals: Refactoring unrelated to the identified audit findings

module_contracts.name: server-core
invariants: Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure to circuit breaker (verification_obligation: test stream failures)
failure_modes: Backend socket reset or timeout (caller receives error SSE or failover to candidate)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates incoming HTTP requests and SSE event structures against JSON schemas

module_contracts.name: backend-auth
invariants: Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential across routing and header construction (verification_obligation: unit test authEnv & backend)
failure_modes: Missing or invalid credential (caller receives unauthenticated error or failover)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates target existence and authorization credential presence

module_contracts.name: config-routing
invariants: Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching to explicitly authorized user prompt blocks (verification_obligation: prompt injection security tests)
failure_modes: Invalid configuration format (throws RoutingError or configuration validation error)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates schema of configuration file and model routing parameters

module_contracts.name: cli-tools
invariants: SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes and flag ordering (verification_obligation: test CLI argument quoting)
failure_modes: Unknown command or invalid flag options
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates CLI option flags and command names
